card.name: Words just before "state" as a region
card.fires_on: Small words like "the", "new", "of", or "federal" right before the word "state" or "states" meaning a region of a country. It also fires before similar region words such as district.

modes.label: Article before state
modes.description: "the" or "each" placed right before "state" in talk of a US state.
modes.example: UT Extension offices in every county in<< the>> state.

modes.label: Modifier before states
modes.description: An adjective or linking word that leads into "state(s)" as a political unit.
modes.example: the admission of<< new>> states which were to be reverted upon the

modes.label: Regional unit names
modes.description: Words inside or before names of foreign states or districts.
modes.example: in the southwest corner of the German<< federal>> state of North Rhine-Westphalia

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict "state" or "states" next and to avoid "province" words.
